posts.name: FearLord
posts.cooked:
Recently got into Sentinels via the digital version, and as a long time fan of comic books and strategy games, I’m loving it so far!

However, I’d like to read up on the characters and storyline a bit more - I have read all the Multiverse stuff in the digital game, and gleaned some things from context in a few places, but would like to know where / how to find out more - is there any other written material I should be looking for, or is everything else fleshed out by the letters page podcast?

Thanks for any help you can give me!

posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
Of note that there's a few actual comics, as well.

The ARG comics are littered with various little interesting looks at events and personalities.

The Tactics games have actual minicomics in the scenario books.

And there's a free comic about the forming of the Freedom Five.

But otherwise, yeah, it's mainly the Multiverse and the Letters Page.
